thread:
sara: CI red on main — infra-deploy job failing in GHA with KMS decrypt AccessDenied. Looks like secrets / token rotation might be related. anyone else seeing this?

jamal: saw the failure in the runner logs earlier. getting KMS error during decrypt step.

sara: log snippet:
```
ERROR: KMSDecryptFailed: AccessDenied
resource: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/deploy-key
operation: decrypt
caller: serviceAccount:github-actions[bot]@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

marta: pinging @oncall and infra — could be the SA lost binding after a rotation.

kevin: if it's AccessDenied likely the key's IAM binding got tightened. Can someone check key policy or if the github-actions SA got removed? Also try a manual rerun after quick check.

sara: I tried a rerun, same failure. I also tried gcloud kms decrypt using the runner SA and it fails locally.

jamal: can you paste the iam policy for the key (redact emails) or the result of `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy`?

devops-bot: Auto: created rerun request #6123 and attached logs. Bisect not started because failure category = secrets_decrypt.

kevin: ok, sounds like infra needs to rebind. @marta can you confirm and re-add the service account? ETA? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

marta: checked: the key IAM is missing the github-actions runner service account binding — looks like a deployment script rolled back bindings. I'm re-adding the role: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to `serviceAccount:github-actions[bot]@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. ETA ~3m.

sara: I will queue another rerun once binding is back. thanks.

devops-bot: Rerun started: https://github.com/redwood-inference/actions/runs/12345678 (rerun id=6124)

jamal: green for head commit. looks like binding fix resolved it. marking as unblocked.

marta: created ticket INFRA-7823 to add an automated check for KMS binding drift and a weekly binding audit. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-7823

kevin: thanks all — note for follow-up: add a small e2e that attempts a test decrypt after any infra key rotation. will follow up in the ticket. :thumbsup:

sara: awesome, closing the CI unblock thread. cheers.
